definitions.explanation: Humble form of あげる, used when giving something to someone of higher status. Shows respect to the recipient.

examples.japanese: お{土産|みやげ}を{差|さ}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: I will give you a souvenir.
examples.notes: Humble expression when giving to someone respected

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}に{花|はな}を{差|さ}し{上|あ}げました。
examples.english: I gave flowers to the teacher.

examples.japanese: お{手伝|てつだ}いを{差|さ}し{上|あ}げましょうか。

notes:
{差|さ}し{上|あ}げる is the humble form of あげる (to give).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

KEIGO FORMS OF あげる:
- あげる: plain (giving to equals/inferiors)
- {差|さ}し{上|あ}げる: humble (giving to superiors)
- くださる: honorific (superior giving to you)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xを{差|さ}し{上|あ}げる: to give X (to someone respected)
- お〜{差|さ}し{上|あ}げる: to do ~ for someone (humble)

[Register: Humble/Formal]

Note: In modern usage, {差|さ}し{上|あ}げる can sound overly formal or servile in some contexts. Use appropriately based on the situation.
